🌍 Welcome to the ultimate **LIVE FLAGS BATTLE**!

Watch flags from countries around the world enter the same arena and fight in a chaotic all-vs-all elimination battle. There are no teams, no fixed matchups, and no guaranteed winner. Every round is unpredictable, and only one flag can survive until the end.

🔥 All countries battle at the same time
⚔️ Random eliminations and intense moments
🏆 Only one nation becomes the champion
🌎 Flags from around the world
🔴 Live action and nonstop battles

Support your country in the live chat and comment which nation you think will win!

Don’t forget to like the stream and subscribe to *World Flags Royale* for more live flag battles.
